entities.name: Fríða Á. Sigurðardóttir
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Fríða Áslaug Sigurðardóttir was an Icelandic novelist and short story writer. She made her literary debut in 1980 with the collection of short stories titled Þetta er ekkert alvarlegt. She was awarded the Nordic Council's Literature Prize in 1992 for the novel Meðan nóttin líður.
